title: Why Everyone Is Watching FedEx (FDX) Today - Simply Wall St

FedEx Was Down to Its Last $5,000 When Its Founder, a Marine Who Served Two Tours in Vietnam, Flew to Las Vegas and Sat Down at a Blackjack Table. He Came Back With $27,000, and the Planes Kept Flying
summary: FedEx was down to about $5,000 when Fred Smith flew to Las Vegas and won $27,000 at blackjack. He called it an omen. The real save was the $11 million he raised next.
